node.title: Paper D v13.2 near-rational support-wise payment
node.statement: REFUTED: common codeword-pair proximity produced by two low-d1 slopes does not imply that no slope is support-wise MCA-bad. In the smooth rate-half code RS[F_17,mu_8,4] at m=5, u=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,1) and v=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,2) satisfy n-3w=m and have low-d1 nonzero-census slopes 8 and 16, yet both slopes possess agreement supports that do not extend to a codeword pair. The final displayed balanced-count inequality of cor:capfp-line is not itself refuted by this witness; its near-rational payment needs a new support-wise argument.
